description: web_analytics.createWebInsightsToggle (POST /web/insights/toggle) declares only the projectId query parameter — no teamId/slug scoping (every other team-scoped Vercel op has them; live-verified the endpoint accepts and honors teamId) — and omits the 404 the live API returns when the project does not exist ({"error":{"code":"not_found","message":"Project not found."}}, live-verified). The WebAnalytics provider's delete path toggles analytics off and must treat a already-deleted project as gone via a typed NotFound tag. Add teamId/slug query params and the 404 response.

value.name: teamId
value.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

value.name: slug
value.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.
